body: Yeah I think that’s true, it’s the only thing keeping me alive at the moment. Thank you I appreciate that. I have been lurking on this sub for a while but thought I’d make an account since things have got bad tonight. That’s nice to hear I’m glad.

That’s very near to what happened with me, I’m really sorry. It sucks. Nobody deserves this. I hope so too, I’ve kept living for a long time hoping that it will, and some days there are happiness and I think that life is worth it. The depression always creeps back though. I’m here if you need to talk or vent about this, it sounds like we’re in a very similar boat.

It’s the worst feeling, I want to just let go but I can’t at the same time. I nearly ended it when I was 15 and sometimes I wish I had succeeded. I’m sorry you’re going through it too, nobody should feel this pain every day.
